title: On well-posedness theory of very weak solutions to Navier-Stokes equations on irregular domains with nonhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary data
summary: The well-posedness theory of very weak solutions is a central topic in mathematical hydrodynamics, especially in the regularity theory for Navier-Stokes equations. It has been fully developed for incompressible fluid flows on bounded domains in R^3 of C^{2,1}-regularity. In this paper, based on the analytic theories in [D. Breit and A. Gaudin, ArXiv Preprint: 2511.19091 (2025)] and [V.G. Maz'ya and T.O.
